name: Complimentary Products Manager For WooCommerce
author: Maulik Virparia

sections.description:
The Complimentary Products Manager For WooCommerce plugin allows store owners to manage complimentary product allocations for specific user roles. It tracks coupon balances, logs transactions, and provides detailed reporting. Key features include:

  • Assign complimentary product coupons to users based on roles.
  • Display coupon balances on user profiles and via shortcodes.
  • Restrict complimentary products to eligible users.
  • Comprehensive transaction logging and CSV report downloads.
  • Shortcode for displaying coupon balance on the frontend: [cpmwc_coupon_balance].
  • Shortcode for displaying coupon balance on the checkout page: [cpmwc_checkout_coupon_balance].
sections.installation:
1. Upload the complimentary-products-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Product Coupons to configure the complimentary product and eligible user roles.
  4. Use the [cpmwc_coupon_balance] shortcode to display coupon balances on the frontend.
  5. Use the [cpmwc_checkout_coupon_balance] shortcode to display coupon balances on the checkout page.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It allows WooCommerce store owners to manage complimentary product allocations, track coupon balances, and generate transaction reports.

How do I configure the complimentary product?

Navigate to Product Coupons in the WordPress admin, select a product, and choose eligible user roles.

Can I display coupon balances on the frontend?

Yes, use the [cpmwc_coupon_balance] shortcode on any page or post, and [cpmwc_checkout_coupon_balance] on the checkout page.
